#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 300;
const int ROOM = -1, REAC = -2, BAD_REAC = -3, CAPS = ROOM;

struct Edge {
    int from, to, rev, flow, cap;
    Edge() {}
    Edge(int f, int t, int r, int fl, int c) : from(f), to(t), rev(r), flow(fl), cap(c) {}
    int residual() { return cap - flow; }
};

class MaxFlow {
public:
    int n;
    vector<Edge*> *graph;
    Edge **parent;
    bool *visited;

    MaxFlow(int size) {
        n = size;
        graph = new vector<Edge*>[n];
        parent = new Edge*[n];
        visited = new bool[n];
    }

    void clear() {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (auto e : graph[i]) delete e;
            graph[i].clear();
        }
    }

    void destroy() {
        clear();
        delete[] parent;
        delete[] visited;
        delete this;
    }

    void add_edge(int s, int t, int capacity) {
        Edge *a = new Edge(s, t, (int)graph[t].size(), 0, capacity);
        Edge *b = new Edge(t, s, (int)graph[s].size(), 0, 0);
        graph[s].push_back(a);
        graph[t].push_back(b);
    }

    void add_undirected(int s, int t, int capacity) {
        Edge *a = new Edge(s, t, (int)graph[t].size(), 0, capacity);
        Edge *b = new Edge(t, s, (int)graph[s].size(), 0, capacity);
        graph[s].push_back(a);
        graph[t].push_back(b);
    }

    bool bfs(int source, int sink) {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            parent[i] = nullptr;
            visited[i] = false;
        }
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(source);
        visited[source] = true;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (u == sink) return true;
            for (auto e : graph[u]) {
                if (!visited[e->to] && e->residual() > 0) {
                    parent[e->to] = e;
                    visited[e->to] = true;
                    q.push(e->to);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    int dfs(int s, int t) {
        int flow = INT_MAX;
        int v = t;
        while (v != s) {
            flow = min(flow, parent[v]->residual());
            v = parent[v]->from;
        }
        v = t;
        while (v != s) {
            parent[v]->flow += flow;
            graph[parent[v]->to][parent[v]->rev]->flow -= flow;
            v = parent[v]->from;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    long long int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        int total_flow = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            total_flow += dfs(s, t);
        }
        return total_flow;
    }
};
